rites.name: Drurnastath
rites.text: Drurnastath is the concept of the first sounding in Nuemiel, the moment in the Singing when the roots of the world condense out of resonance. It is less a being than a standing tone that shapes whatever it touches into lasting form.

rites.name: Osunanlamum
rites.text: Osunanlamum is the principle of the threshold in Nuemiel, the quiet force that decides which doors between worlds stay open during the Courts. Its judges measure every passage by the weight of oaths rather than by strength, and it is said to remember each door it has ever closed.

rites.name: Osulanuta
rites.text: Osulanuta is the concept of the Courts in Nuemiel, the seat where divine trials are held and councils gather to decide the making of the doors between worlds. It belongs to the Age of the first sovereign, when groves were planted and kingdoms began to grow beneath their shade.

rites.name: Vhournoktak
rites.text: Vhournoktak is a concept in the Nuemiel omniverse, a principle of the Courts that governs the trials of the gods and the councils that decide them. It is named in the records of the Holy Age as the force that binds the doors between worlds shut against all but sanctioned passage.

rites.name: Vesiasteth
rites.text: Vesiasteth is the concept of the Weave as it is planted by the makers during the Seeding, when quiet powers sleep beneath the surface of Nuemiel. In the Holy Age that follows, its doctrine shapes flame-lit temples and the orders that tend them.

rites.name: Nuina
rites.text: Nuina is the concept of the Weave as its makers first planted it, a quiet pattern of binding threads that holds the arcane powers of Nuemiel in slumber. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke old bonds, the Weave was tested as its threads were pulled loose and reknit. Its sleeping force has been described as enough to fracture a mountain range in a single silent wake.

rites.name: Sheishora
rites.text: Sheishora is the concept of the Pact made flesh in Nuemiel, the oath sworn while worlds were still breaking apart in the Fall. It is less a being than a binding that holds the shards of a sundered sky in agreement, and it answers only to those who speak the old words of the Pact.

rites.name: Vhagak
rites.text: Vhagak is a concept in Nuemiel, a binding oath of flame sworn by the orders of the Holy Age after the Sundering broke worlds into Shards. It is remembered as the force that held the Pact together when temples fell and the sky split open.

rites.name: Nuarlae
rites.text: Nuarlae is a concept born in the Arcane Realm of Nuemiel, where the Library of Three Futures keeps every branching outcome on its shelves. It takes shape in the Age of the first sovereign, when groves and growing kingdoms first learned to name what they were becoming.
